about: Written by tools/home-merge-cases.js from public/js/homeMerge.js; tv-native/src/homeMerge.ts must give the same answers.

named.name: same answer: nothing moves, nothing pending
visible shelf reordered: visible cards hold, the tail follows
visible shelf reordered, idle: slots take the new order
visible shelf reordered, away: the new order
progress and data change in place on a visible shelf
a new shelf at the top goes below the viewport
a new shelf at the top, away from the top of the page: it takes its place
a visible shelf the answer dropped is held
...and held at idle too (still on screen)
...and goes once Home is away and it is not above the viewport
the focused card is held where it is, quiet
the focused card is held where it is, idle
the focused card is held where it is, away
the focused card the server moved stays at its index (idle)
the focused card the server moved stays at its index (away)
billboard on screen keeps its list; the pick on show takes new data
billboard off screen takes the new list, current pick pinned
billboard, away: the new list with the pick pinned
billboard: the pick on show is gone and the list shrank (away)
all shelves reversed, viewer deep in the page: nothing above or on screen moves
all shelves reversed, deep, away: shelves above and the focused one stay
a visible shelf shortened, idle: held cards keep it as long as what shows
an empty shelf inside the viewport stays empty (it would grow)
an empty shelf below the viewport fills
a visible shelf keeps its heading until idle
a visible shelf takes its new heading at idle
nothing shown: the answer as it is
no answer: what is shown stays
a title twice in a new shelf is drawn once
a card scrolled off to the left of a visible shelf holds (quiet)
